extras: macOS and desktop-only; no analytics or remote services used.
intentEvidence: Lacewing Window Transparency is a macOS-first Obsidian plugin for making the main vault window or any pop-out translucent and keeping selected windows above other apps.
problem: Users need a way to keep notes visible and readable while working in other applications or video calls without losing context.
summary: Lacewing Window Transparency is a macOS plugin that allows users to control the opacity and always-on-top status of Obsidian windows with per-window settings.
